title: Session
description: Wire shapes of the session routes (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 8, ADR-022, ADR-097). Each message is a definition under $defs.

admin.description: True for the admin (ADMIN_EMAIL), who sees the admin page (M10.3).

SessionResponse.description: Answer to POST /api/session and GET /api/session when signed in (HTTP 200). Not signed in is HTTP 401 with an ErrorResponse.

SignInOptions.description: Answer to GET /api/session/options: how this site signs people in (AUTH_MODE, ADR-097). "password" for the seeded local test users, "google" for Google sign-in on the live site.
